description: Verify that DUT accepts a SYN with seq = 0 and emits SYN,ACK with ack_num == 1 (RFC 793 §3.1)
approach:
[Objective]
seq=0 is a legal ISN (the sequence space is modulo 2^32). DUT must process it normally and ack with 1.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN with seq=0.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK with ack_num == 1.

[Pass condition]
DUT SYN,ACK ack_num == 1.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_wrong_ack_num — ack_num not 1
• Fail_timeout — no SYN,ACK

verdicts.Pass: DUT acked seq=0 with ack=1 — normal
verdicts.Fail_wrong_ack_num: DUT SYN,ACK ack_num not 1 for zero ISN
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT SYN,ACK within listen window
